TITLE: Reassignment of Responsibilities and Contract Review for Mominen Dosalen

To: Rekuen Telnelen  
From: Finance Compliance Team  
Date: April 3, 2025  
Subject: Update on Mominen Dosalen’s Contract and Cost Center Adjustments  

Mominen Dosalen, who has been with Zastama Industries since 2016, is currently assigned to cost center ZV-8897-D. As part of the ongoing internal audit and resource reallocation initiative, the Finance Compliance Team has initiated a review of her existing contract, CN-9430-U, to ensure alignment with current departmental structures and budgetary responsibilities.  

The review process includes an assessment of the cost center’s allocation to determine its continued appropriateness given the evolving scope of Mominen Dosalen’s role and the broader departmental strategy. Over the past decade, Mominen Dosalen has contributed to a variety of initiatives, and it has become necessary to reassess the financial and operational parameters under which her work is currently categorized. The Finance Compliance Team is coordinating with Rekuen Telnelen’s team to confirm whether there are any specific process or project dependencies tied to the current cost center assignment.  

Rekuen Telnelen, as the Product Manager overseeing the relevant initiatives, has been requested to provide input on whether the current classification supports the team’s operational needs. While the process is ongoing, no immediate changes to the cost center or contract are expected to impact day-to-day activities. However, the potential for reassignment or restructuring is being considered as part of the broader audit.  

As part of the review, Mominen Dosalen’s contract, CN-9430-U, will be evaluated for any necessary amendments. This includes a review of the contract’s terms to ensure they are consistent with both current company policies and the projected trajectory of her role. The Finance Compliance Team is also in the process of engaging with the relevant internal stakeholders to confirm that all contractual obligations remain viable and enforceable within the current framework.  

Given that Mominen Dosalen has been with the company for nearly nine years, this review is also an opportunity to ensure that her contract remains aligned with both her contributions and the company’s strategic priorities. The Finance Compliance Team will provide a detailed summary of their findings and recommendations by the end of the month, at which point Rekuen Telnelen and other relevant parties will be invited to participate in the next phase of discussion.  

It is important to note that this process is not an indication of performance concerns or contractual issues, but rather a routine measure to ensure that all employee contracts and cost center allocations remain up to date and accurate. Rekuen Telnelen is encouraged to reach out with any specific questions or concerns, particularly if there are project-specific considerations that should be taken into account during the review.  

Zastama Industries remains committed to maintaining clear and effective financial and operational structures, and this review is part of that ongoing effort. All parties involved are being asked to treat this process as a collaborative one, with the goal of ensuring that the final outcome supports both individual and team objectives.  

Should any additional information become available or if adjustments to the timeline are required, the Finance Compliance Team will communicate the changes directly with Rekuen Telnelen and other stakeholders.  

Thank you for your attention to this matter and for your continued cooperation.
